node: Tungsten APT intermediate processing and WF6 semiconductor gas
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the tungsten APT/WF6 node with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane: large industrial-gas suppliers with explicit WF6/electronic-specialty-gas exposure. Underfollowed lane: smaller public tungsten asset/tooling names whose exposure is more direct to tungsten concentrate, carbide powders, or downstream tooling demand. The strongest direct US-listed names found in this pass are Almonty Industries for upstream non-China tungsten concentrate optionality and Kennametal for tungsten carbide/tooling and tungsten-powder-linked downstream exposure. Air Products and Linde are included mainly as reference anchors because they have explicit WF6/electronic-gas evidence but are large diversified companies where WF6 is likely a small part of total value.
